display_name: Hanoi Láng extreme heat replay — 26 May 2026
description: A source-grounded 15-minute replay derived from ERA5 and calibrated to Láng station's reported 41.1°C daily maximum.

source.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com; ERA5 data from Copernicus Climate Change Service.
source.modifications: Hourly ERA5 values were temporally interpolated to 15 minutes. Temperature was affinely calibrated to the reported Láng daily maximum; precipitation was divided across each hour's four intervals.

calibration_anchor.limitations: Only the 41.1°C daily maximum is a reported station observation. The intraday curve is derived from a coarse ERA5 grid cell and is not direct 15-minute station telemetry.

method_by_field.temperature_c: Affine range calibration followed by linear interpolation.
method_by_field.relative_humidity_percent: Bounded linear interpolation of ERA5 hourly values.
method_by_field.apparent_temperature_c: Bounded linear interpolation of uncalibrated ERA5 hourly values.
method_by_field.precipitation_mm: Each ERA5 hourly accumulation divided equally among four 15-minute intervals.
method_by_field.cloud_cover_pct: Bounded linear interpolation of ERA5 hourly values.
method_by_field.wind_speed_mps: Bounded linear interpolation of ERA5 hourly values.
method_by_field.wind_gust_mps: Bounded linear interpolation of ERA5 hourly values.
method_by_field.shortwave_radiation_wm2: Bounded linear interpolation of ERA5 hourly values.

zone_weather_offset_method.derivation: Center the ten prior zone temperatures on their city mean, multiply deviations by 0.35, round to 0.1 C, and preserve an exactly zero city-wide mean.
zone_weather_offset_method.limitations: Offsets preserve only the scenario's relative microclimate ordering. They are deterministic simulation inputs, not district-level observations or forecasts.

operational_priors.interpretation: Phase 2 may use existing zone fleet and demand values as explicit simulator priors; Phase 1 does not generate operational state.

disclaimer: This is a simulated replay for prototype evaluation. It combines one reported station maximum with ERA5 reanalysis, calibration, and interpolation; it is not live telemetry or a direct station time series.
